Resolves #19201

CONTRIBUTING's good-first-issue and help-wanted links now carry `no:assignee`, so a ticket someone already holds drops off the list a newcomer browses. On 2026-09-25 a second claimant landed on #19143 thirteen hours after it was assigned.

Evidence: L1 (a documentation diff) → L1 required.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the CI baseline jobs ran.
